hero.name: Aman Maurya
hero.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
hero.bio: Mechanical Engineering student with hands-on experience in CAD design and machine mechanisms. Skilled in AutoCAD and SolidWorks, with practical exposure to drafting, 3D modeling, and mechanism development. Seeking a Mechanical Design Job to apply engineering fundamentals and contribute to real-world product development.

profile.title: Mechanical Engineering Student
profile.bio1: Hi! I'm Aman Maurya, a passionate Mechanical Engineering student currently pursuing B.Tech (3rd Year) at CIPET IPT–Jaipur. I have a keen interest in CAD design, research and development, new product development and enjoy creating precise, efficient, and functional models that bring engineering concepts to life.
profile.bio2: I have hands-on experience with AutoCAD and SolidWorks, along with practical exposure to 2D drafting, 3D modelling, mechanism design and prototype development.

skillCategories.description: Parametric part design, multi-body assemblies, weldments, and feature-based modeling.
Standardized manufacturing production drawings and geometric dimensioning.
Kinematic mechanisms, power transmission, and functional machine elements.
Hands-on industrial maintenance, workshop technology, and manufacturing processes.

expertise.description: 2D drafting and 3D mechanical design using AutoCAD and SolidWorks, with focus on accurate engineering drawings and practical design solutions.

expertise.title: 3D Modelling
expertise.description: Creation of detailed 3D parts, components and assemblies with proper dimensions, constraints and engineering design considerations.

expertise.title: Machine Design
expertise.description: Design and development of machine components and mechanisms with focus on strength, functionality, reliability and manufacturability.

expertise.title: Product Design
expertise.description: Practical product development from concept to 3D model, focusing on functionality, ease of manufacturing and real-world engineering requirements.

projects.title: Geneva Wheel Mechanism
projects.description: Designed and developed a 6-slot Geneva Wheel Mechanism as a B.Tech 4th Semester team Minor project to convert continuous rotary motion into precise intermittent motion for industrial indexing applications.
projects.objective: Design, kinematic modeling, and precision indexing validation of a 6-slot intermittent motion mechanism for automated production indexing.
projects.mechanicalConcept: 6-slot internal/external Geneva drive converting steady rotational input from a driving pin into intermittent angular stepping motion with zero pin clearance binding.
outcomes: Simulated angular velocity and acceleration profiles using MATLAB
Fabricated working prototype validating indexing dwell intervals
Achieved smooth pin entry and exit without kinematic shock

projects.title: Solar Tracking System
projects.description: Designed and developed a Solar Tracking System as a Polytechnic Final Year Major Project to enhance solar panel efficiency through automatic sun tracking without external power using mechanical principles.
projects.objective: Develop an autonomous sun tracking mechanical structure optimizing solar radiation incidence angle across diurnal sun trajectories.
projects.mechanicalConcept: Balanced mechanical linkages and pivot assemblies translating angular movement to follow azimuth and elevation paths for continuous photovoltaic exposure.
outcomes: Constructed operational scaled prototype using 3D printed brackets and mechanical pivot linkage
Measured up to 35% improvement in daylight energy collection compared to stationary horizontal mounts
Presented design defense and awarded Best Polytechnic Final Year Project

projects.title: Machine Component Design
projects.description: Designed a precision machine component with detailed 3D modelling and engineering drawing using SolidWorks and AutoCAD with complete dimensional accuracy and GD&T adherence.
projects.objective: Create production-ready CAD geometry and ASME Y14.5 manufacturing drawings for high-tolerance machine elements.
projects.mechanicalConcept: Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) datum selection, form, orientation, and runout control for CNC machine production.
outcomes: Drafted complete orthographic, sectional, and isometric blueprints with machining allowances
Applied ASME Y14.5 positional tolerances and fit clearances for shaft-bore engagement
Verified parametric feature tree hierarchy for design intent maintenance

projects.title: Assembly Design & Analysis
projects.description: Created a complete assembly model with motion analysis and interference checking using SolidWorks. Optimized the assembly for manufacturability and performance.
projects.objective: Build multi-component mechanical assembly with kinematic constraints, motion simulation, and physical interference verification.
projects.mechanicalConcept: Multi-body mechanical mating (coincident, concentric, distance), degree of freedom constraint resolution, and dynamic motion path analysis.
outcomes: Conducted 3D collision detection and verified clearance throughout full stroke range
Auto-generated structured Bill of Materials (BOM) with standardized fastener callouts
Optimized component wall thicknesses and mating fillets for reduced assembly stress
